I had the same problem in Godot 4.6.2. stable mono on Fedora 43/Linux. Every time I'd delete a file/folder, from within the Godot editor, it crashed the engine. For me the problem seemed to have something to do with custom ssd mounts that I was using. To fix it for me I removed these custom /etc/fstab entries:

```code
/mnt/ssd                             /home/chuckie/ssd                    none  bind,nofail  0  0
/mnt/ssd/programming  /home/chuckie/programming  none  bind,nofail  0  0
```

And simply replaced them with symlinks like the following:

```code
ln -s /mnt/ssd/programming /home/chuckie/programming
ln -s /mnt/ssd /home/chuckie/ssd
```

This fixes the crash for me completely. I don't think this is gonna fix the problem for everyone, but I thought I should mention it as it helped me fix it. I should also mention that Godot just creates a .Trash-1000 folder for me under /mnt/ssd/.Trash-1000 if it isn't there or if I deleted it myself before.
